tasks.description: Repair reviewer P2: a permanent refresh rejection removes the queue item but is incorrectly shown as a successful refresh in the English card.
constraints: This is a Developer write task from iOS 0aa143f. Author a valid unified Git patch in the JSON patch field; read-only workspace forbids applying it locally. The controller writes and runs the checks.

Only the matching direct refresh invocation should surface the terminal result; preserve existing outbox handling for unrelated commands and background sync. Permanent CONFLICT/FORBIDDEN/VALIDATION_ERROR/NOT_FOUND clears the discarded refresh and reports failure. An absent queue item alone is not a confirmed refresh. A valid paused receipt remains a confirmed result. Retryable loss leaves the exact operation pending; do not mark it failed permanently.

Update the EN card state to clear pending for a discarded refresh and show failure, without a success/no-next result. Preserve account/session guard, transport behavior and exact request. Add a focused CollectionWireTests regression for discard failure and exact pending/valid refresh behavior. Do not change staging, Swift project files, backend wire or time/date rules.

acceptance_criteria.description: Build and iOS unit tests prove a terminal rejection has a distinct outcome, clears that pending command, and loss/restart preserves exact replay.
Both existing EN restart XCUITests still pass on fixtures.
